    • build

      public net.minecraft.core.Holder<BiomeLayer> build()
      Builds the BiomeLayer. This method returns an intrusive holder that must be properly added to the registry. RegistryProviderBase does this automatically if the result is stored in a public, non-static field inside the provider.
